title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs Terms: Activation, Expiration and Renewal
content:
These terms govern when an enrollment in the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs becomes usable, when it expires, and when it may be renewed or applied for again.

**Section 1 — Activation.** Where a program type does not require activation, the program is activated on the day it is enrolled. Otherwise it is activated by its first paid program claim where the program type is activated by first claim, by the award letter's start date for a foundation grant, or by payment of the membership fee for a club.

**Section 2 — Activation window.** An enrollment is activated no later than the date the patient enrolled plus the activation window days, counted in calendar days with the enrollment date as day 0; an enrollment not activated by then expires. The clock starts from the enrollment date the system shows on the enrollment; the last permitted day is itself allowed.

| Hypothetical enrollment with a 30-day window | Result |
|---|---|
| Activation on day 30 after the enrollment date | Within the window (the boundary day counts) |
| Activation not done by the end of day 30 | The enrollment expires |
| Hypothetical 14-day window: activation on day 14 | Within the window |
| Hypothetical 14-day window: activation first attempted on day 15 | Outside the window; the enrollment has expired |

**Section 3 — Expiration date.** Where a program has an expiration date, the expiration date is the activation date plus the membership term in months, a month-end falling back to the last day of a shorter month, and the program expires on the day after it. *Hypothetical:* activated on August 31 with a 6-month term, the expiration date is the last day of February, and the program expires on March 1.

**Section 4 — Automatic renewal.** The clause "a membership whose auto-renewal is on renews at expiration for another membership term and charges the enrollment fee again as an annual renewal" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for club renewal fees.

**Section 5 — Uncollected renewal charge.** The clause "where that charge cannot be collected, program prices are still honored for the renewal grace days and the membership then expires" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**Section 6 — Enrolling again.** A program that may not be enrolled again after expiry is never enrolled again for the same drug. A program that may be enrolled again may be renewed or re-applied for no earlier than the renewal lead days before its expiration date.

**Section 7 — Household members.** Household members are added or removed only on a family membership, and never above that membership's maximum number of covered people.
